new_page.title: Vancouver Penthouses for Sale | Prices and Buildings
new_page.description: Search Vancouver penthouses for sale. 220 sold over the past ten months at a median of $930,000, with prices by neighbourhood and building.

faq.q: How much does a penthouse cost in Vancouver?
faq.a: The 220 penthouses that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $930,000, with the middle half between $685,625 and $1,315,000. All Vancouver condos had a median of $737,500.

faq.q: How does a Vancouver penthouse compare in price with other condos?
faq.a: A penthouse cost 26% more at the median, or $1,006 a square foot against $979 for all condos. Compare the floor area, the strata fee and the roof or terrace before you decide.

faq.q: How fast do Vancouver penthouses sell?
faq.a: 19 days at a median, closing at 97.4% of list, with 11% over the list price.

faq.q: What counts as a penthouse in Vancouver?
faq.a: 220 of the 3,077 Vancouver condo sales carried Penthouse in the style field, most of them in Kitsilano (26 sales). The listing agent enters that, so some top-floor homes are unmarked and a marked one is not always on the very top floor.

faq.q: Do Vancouver penthouses have higher strata fees?
faq.a: The median strata fee was $613 a month for penthouses and $537 for all condos.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists penthouses for sale in Vancouver West and Vancouver East: top-floor condos that the listing marks as a penthouse. It covers the downtown peninsula, Kitsilano, Fairview, Mount Pleasant and the east side. Other condos, townhomes and houses are separate searches.

220 Vancouver penthouses closed from November 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026, out of 3,077 condo sales in the same area and months. The median penthouse sold for $930,000, 26% more than the $737,500 median for all condos, in 19 days at a median.

42% of Vancouver penthouses sold for $1,000,000 or more, compared with 24% of all condos in the same months.
About buying a top-floor home in Vancouver

In Yaletown the Canada Line stops at Yaletown-Roundhouse, and the Yaletown Historic Area (HA-3) limits building height to 21.4 metres. Parts of False Creek North are exposed to flooding as sea level rises, so ask a strata in that area what it has planned.
The Empty Homes Tax charges 3% of assessed value on a home that is neither occupied nor rented.
Before you offer on a Vancouver penthouse

items.t: Ask when the building last replaced its roof, and read the depreciation report for the cost of the next one.
Ask about water-ingress claims and envelope repairs from the past ten years, and what the strata’s insurance deductible is.
Confirm whether a roof deck or terrace is part of your strata lot, limited common property or common property, since that decides who may build, repair and use it.
Visit at different hours. Mechanical rooms and elevator machinery above a top floor can be loud, and afternoon sun heats some suites.

Compare the building’s fee with the $613 a month median for Vancouver penthouses and $537 for all condos. A fee well above that deserves a look at what it covers. The median Vancouver penthouse sold was built in 2005.
